quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.flavor: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

quotes.name: Hive Mind Coprocessor
quotes.flavor: "Consensus achieved. Disseminating."

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

quotes.name: Fabricate
quotes.flavor:
"I'm one masterpiece away from ruling this pathetic world."
—Saldrath, master artificer

quotes.name: Geistlight Snare
quotes.flavor: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

quotes.name: Meng Huo's Horde
quotes.flavor: Through his allies, Meng Huo commanded several hundred thousand troops composed of cavalry, rattan-armored warriors, infantry, naked men with swords, and wild animals.

quotes.name: Roast
quotes.flavor:
"Intruders in the lands of Atarka have but two choices: be consumed by fire, or be consumed by maw."
—Ulnok, Atarka shaman

quotes.name: Flaying Tendrils
quotes.flavor: Only one Eldrazi stood against them, yet the defenders were outnumbered.

quotes.name: Tarrian's Journal // The Tomb of Aclazotz
quotes.flavor: Though officially deemed a heretic for his reverent writings on Aclazotz, Tarrian is viewed as a holy martyr by the most radical sects of the Church of Dusk.

quotes.name: Rootborn Defenses
quotes.flavor: "No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."

quotes.name: Tymora's Invoker
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "May Lady Luck smile upon you some other day, pal."

quotes.name: Browbeat
quotes.flavor:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

quotes.name: Elite Inquisitor
quotes.flavor: "No matter how many I kill, there are always more to hunt. It makes me smile just to think about it."

quotes.name: Illvoi Operative
quotes.flavor: The Uthros Combine's first question for any scientific breakthrough is always: "How can this be used to keep our next breakthrough secret?"

quotes.name: Lumengrid Warden
quotes.flavor: His peers derive knowledge from ancient tomes locked within dark spires. He finds knowledge within the solitude of a lifetime spent watching the Quicksilver Sea.

quotes.name: Deploy the Gatewatch
quotes.flavor: Gideon and Liliana may not have seen eye to eye, but that did not stop them from fighting side by side.

quotes.name: Delver of Secrets // Insectile Aberration
quotes.flavor:
"Unfortunately, all my test animals have died or escaped, so I shall be the final subject. I feel no fear. This is a momentous night."
—Laboratory notes, final entry

quotes.name: Levitation
quotes.flavor: The horses of Scytha's army must be well trained. A thrown rider would fall miles before meeting the ground.

quotes.name: Reassembling Skeleton
quotes.flavor:
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Kher Keep
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"They're still here?! The cockroach may have finally met its match."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Gravewaker
quotes.flavor: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

quotes.name: Kharis & The Beholder
quotes.flavor: #sponsored

quotes.name: Urza's Mine
quotes.flavor: In his hunger for power and knowledge, Urza dug deep into Dominaria's ancient past.

quotes.name: Rise from the Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Angel's Mercy
quotes.flavor:
"She rose above me, and in that moment Varrik the Bloody died and I was born."
—Varrik the Just

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: Changing Rath's landscape is like tearing the scab from a wound.

quotes.name: Atzocan Archer
quotes.flavor: His arrows are fletched with feathers from the greatest of the winged dinosaurs.

quotes.name: Tel-Jilad Archers
quotes.flavor: They are extensions of the Tangle, stretching its vines into the furthest reaches of the sky.

quotes.name: Innocent Blood
quotes.flavor: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

quotes.name: Gaea's Herald
quotes.flavor: "Gaea sings with the voice of nature rampant: a thousand howls, chitters, and cries, and none of them can be ignored."

quotes.name: Mouth to Mouth
quotes.flavor: Interesting tidbit: Surveys show that the card Ow has one of the most popular pieces of flavor text in the *Unglued* expansion.

quotes.name: Summit Prowler
quotes.flavor:
"Do you hunt the yetis of the high peaks, stripling? They are as fierce as the bear that fears no foe and as sly as the mink that creeps unseen. You will be as much prey as they."
—Nitula, the Hunt Caller

quotes.name: Snickering Squirrel
quotes.flavor: "In this line of work, you've got to know how to squirrel things away. Quite literally, in my case."

quotes.name: Pterafractyl
quotes.flavor:
"Be careful when traversing the Paradox Gardens. Not all experiments are perfectly contained."
—Professor Berta

quotes.name: Unleash Fury
quotes.flavor:
"We let you both live and you wasted it."
—Abby

quotes.name: Back from the Brink
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, death is just a career change.

quotes.name: Dread Rider
quotes.flavor:
"What kind of monstrous grave robber leaves the treasures, but takes the bodies?"
—Fjall, Beskir elder

quotes.name: Okoye, Mighty and Adored
quotes.flavor: "My king is merciful. I am not."

quotes.name: Lavaleaper
quotes.flavor: Flamekin believe it knows the slopes of Mount Kulrath even better than they do.

quotes.name: Stone Quarry
quotes.flavor: The Sun Empire's cities are built from the bones of the earth.

quotes.name: Melesse Spirit
quotes.flavor: Like a laughing knife, immaculate and sharp, is the Melesse.

quotes.name: Spitebellows
quotes.flavor: Disaster stalks with gaping jaws across unready lands.

quotes.name: Harbinger of Night
quotes.flavor:
Embrace the Harbinger
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "abandon hope"

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"I love old things. They make me feel sad."
—Sally Sparrow

quotes.name: Vengeful Dead
quotes.flavor: Those who don't learn from their deaths are destined to repeat them.

quotes.name: Moonlit Lamenter
quotes.flavor: Isilu's adherents mourn the dead, purging grief through keening rituals.

quotes.name: Treasure Hunt
quotes.flavor:
"The longer the journey, the more one learns."
—Isanke, Halimar seastalker

quotes.name: Expedition Map
quotes.flavor:
"I use maps to find out where explorers have already been. Then I go the other way."
—Javad Nasrin, Ondu relic hunter

quotes.name: Scavenger Grounds
quotes.flavor: The only things you need out in the wastes are food, water, and bullets. Everything else is details.

quotes.name: Tale of Katara and Toph
quotes.flavor: "It's about time we did something fun together."

quotes.name: Dregs of Sorrow
quotes.flavor: Crovax gazed upon the dead, and for one dark moment he saw a banquet.

quotes.name: Impose Hierarchy
quotes.flavor:
"Only the best speak at the Forum of Amity. If you can't stand up to us, you'll never survive in there."
—Esteel, Silverquill page

quotes.name: Colfenor, the Last Yew
quotes.flavor: "To reach my age, you must know when to bend with the winds and when to stand tall."

quotes.name: Worldly Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"A single chord brings them to heel. A whole song, and they dance."
—Yisan, the wanderer bard

quotes.name: Cloak of Mists
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor: Mystery lies beneath the haunting mists. Never stay where obscurity deepens.

quotes.name: Mightstone
quotes.flavor: While exploring the sacred cave of Koilos with his brother Mishra and their master Tocasia, Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

quotes.name: Fyndhorn Elder
quotes.flavor: "It is useful to be able to speak to the trees. But it is truly wondrous to be able to listen to them."

quotes.name: Cutthroat Maneuver
quotes.flavor: "Our ambition drives us forward. Together we will claim what is ours, no matter who holds it."

quotes.name: Mechanized Production
quotes.flavor:
"Give me eight walkers, I'll give you the city."
—Dovin Baan

quotes.name: Sky Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"Like a strain of music: easy to remember but impossible to catch."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Grievous Wound
quotes.flavor: Vicky was so tired. The pain began to fade. "You were so brave," said her grandmother's voice from somewhere far away. "But it's time to rest now."

quotes.name: Don & Leo, Problem Solvers
quotes.flavor: "Hey, watch it, Leonardo. You're ruining my finish!"

quotes.name: Rogue Elephant
quotes.flavor:
"When are trees like grass?"
—*The One Thousand Questions*

quotes.name: Watchful Radstag
quotes.flavor: Don't mistake timidness for defenselessness.

quotes.name: Lumbering Laundry
quotes.flavor: A true crime of fashion.

quotes.name: Fateful Handoff
quotes.flavor:
"Get the sylex to Urza at any cost. Tell him to fill it with memories of the land."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

quotes.name: Navigation Orb
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Travel the world without ever leaving the comfort of home.

quotes.name: Bloodtithe Collector
quotes.flavor: For the more refined vampire, breaking a victim's will is far more satisfying than simply taking their blood.

quotes.name: Daring Apprentice
quotes.flavor: In front of every great wizard is a doomed apprentice.

quotes.name: Warden of Evos Isle
quotes.flavor: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

quotes.name: Phantom Monster
quotes.flavor:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

quotes.name: Seething Song
quotes.flavor: Vulshok mana rituals echo the day when the red sun burst through Mirrodin's surface to take its place in the heavens.

quotes.name: Wizard Mentor
quotes.flavor: "I hope you took notes before it exploded."

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor:
"It is up to the planet to decide. What is best for the planet. What is bad for the planet. All that is bad will disappear."
—Bugenhagen

quotes.name: Price of Glory
quotes.flavor: "FIRE! FIRE! FIRE!"

quotes.name: Sarcomite Myr
quotes.flavor:
"A horrible sight, yes, but the sounds . . . Its twanging tendons and grinding gears are almost musical."
—Brudiclad, Telchor engineer

quotes.name: Arcane Denial
quotes.flavor:
"Your mundane wizardry will not harm the Sorcerer Supreme."
—Doctor Strange

quotes.name: Tempted by the Oriq
quotes.flavor: To exact his vengeance, Extus needed followers. His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

quotes.name: Choked Estuary
quotes.flavor: Centuries' worth of black iron lie beneath the soil of every Imperial world, their civilization built on never-ending strife.

quotes.name: Krosan Grip
quotes.flavor:
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough."
—Zyd, Kamahlite druid

quotes.name: Dismember
quotes.flavor:
"You serve Phyrexia. Your pieces would better serve Phyrexia elsewhere."
—Azax-Azog, the Demon Thane

quotes.name: Sword of Vengeance
quotes.flavor: When wielded by a true believer, it matters little whether the sword is a relic or a replica.

quotes.name: Palladium Myr
quotes.flavor: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

quotes.name: Peter Parker // Amazing Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: "Time to swing into action!"

quotes.name: Doom Whisperer
quotes.flavor: The sound of every twisted secret tempts you to hear another.

quotes.name: Shu Soldier-Farmers
quotes.flavor: During Kongming's campaigns against the Wei, his Shu troops rotated from the battlefront to the fields every hundred days.

quotes.name: Fateful Absence
quotes.flavor: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

quotes.name: Aura Shards
quotes.flavor: Only one loyal subject did not fear the wrath of the Marchioness—her beloved "Fluffin."

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"I had to make them pay for what I discovered. They lied to us, the founding fathers of Gallifrey. Everything we were told was a lie."
—The Master

quotes.name: Flame Jab
quotes.flavor:
"Fire's out. Should be safe now."
—Gnarltrunk

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.flavor: Nature doesn't walk.

quotes.name: Skycloud Expanse
quotes.flavor: Most denizens of the Imperial hive city live and die without ever setting foot inside the towering skyscrapers of the ruling class.

quotes.name: Macabre Reconstruction
quotes.flavor:
"Eyewitness testimony, coming right up! Just let me finish regenerating their eyes."
—Nelo, Agency coroner

quotes.name: Great Furnace
quotes.flavor: Kuldotha, wellspring of molten metal, temple of the goblin horde.

quotes.name: Sunset Saboteur
quotes.flavor: "Lightsick fools. All suns eventually set."

quotes.name: Warstorm Surge
quotes.flavor: "Listen to the roar! Feel the thunder! The Immersturm shouts its approval with every bolt of lightning!"

quotes.name: Mesa Enchantress
quotes.flavor: She shepherds mysteries and dust as others would a flock of sheep.

quotes.name: Overlaid Terrain
quotes.flavor: One must reap before one can sow.

quotes.name: Arc Lightning
quotes.flavor: Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.

quotes.name: Spider-Suit
quotes.flavor: Nothing beats the classic look.

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: Conjured from the bowels of hell, the fiery wall forms an impassable barrier, searing the soul of any creature attempting to pass through its terrible bursts of flame.

quotes.name: Phantasmal Forces
quotes.flavor: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

quotes.name: Bonecrusher Giant // Stomp
quotes.flavor: Not every tale ends in glory.

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Molten Rain
quotes.flavor: When the molten rains fall, entire landscapes melt and flow away in rivulets of fire.

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

quotes.name: Shadow in the Warp
quotes.flavor: The astropath collapsed, his empty eye sockets aglow. He spoke three words before falling lifeless to the ground: "They . . . are . . . coming!"

quotes.name: River's Rebuke
quotes.flavor: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

quotes.name: Frankie Peanuts
quotes.flavor: Don't cross him or you'll end up sleeping with the merfolk.

quotes.name: Mind Sculpt
quotes.flavor:
"Your mind was a curious mix of madness and genius. I just took away the genius."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Syr Elenora, the Discerning
quotes.flavor: She rode forth from Vantress an emissary, a marshal, and a paragon of style.

quotes.name: Lantern Bearer // Lanterns' Lift
quotes.flavor: Val didn't know what the silent geist was offering . . .

quotes.name: Flamewave Invoker
quotes.flavor: The Mirari burns in his heart.

quotes.name: Clever Combo
quotes.flavor: At Crossbreed Labs, "heads or tails" has nothing to do with coins.

quotes.name: Explore
quotes.flavor: The Tyranids advance inexorably across the galaxy in their living Hive Ships, with one singular goal: to consume all.

quotes.name: Orzhov Signet
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

quotes.name: Arena Athlete
quotes.flavor: The Iroan Games award no medals. Athletes vie for a visit from Iroas, god of victory.

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor: The crystal pulsed with the power of Teferi's Planeswalker spark. Had Jhoira given him a blessing or a curse?

quotes.name: Mortus Strider
quotes.flavor: Dimir's best agents hide from death itself.

quotes.name: Furious Rise
quotes.flavor: Klothys set out to mend the destiny of Theros, her fury guiding every stitch.

quotes.name: Inspired Ultimatum
quotes.flavor:
"Inner peace is wonderful, and worth striving for. Outer peace is much less important."
—Taelya, Lavabrink pyromage

quotes.name: Soltari Trooper
quotes.flavor:
"Dauthi blood is Soltari wine."
—Soltari Tales of Life

quotes.name: Overrun
quotes.flavor:
"You want to know your enemy? Look at your feet while you trample him."
—Tahngarth of the Weatherlight

quotes.name: Tower Gargoyle
quotes.flavor:
"Esper, like any work of art, can be truly appreciated only from a distance."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

quotes.name: Isleback Spawn
quotes.flavor: The more deadly the lake monster, the shorter the tale.

quotes.name: Elvish Champion
quotes.flavor:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Elvish hymn

quotes.name: Goblin Warchief
quotes.flavor: They poured from the Skirk Ridge like lava, burning and devouring everything in their path.

quotes.name: Flowstone Wyvern
quotes.flavor:
"Where I come from, stone stays on the ground."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
quotes.flavor: The reach of Atlantis travels far beyond the waves.

quotes.name: Canopy Spider
quotes.flavor: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

quotes.name: Sanitation Automaton
quotes.flavor: "I am once again bursting with discarded theories. Disposal imminent."

quotes.name: Offer Immortality
quotes.flavor: "Give all you are to Phyrexia, and you will receive more than you could have ever desired."

quotes.name: Sheltered Thicket
quotes.flavor:
"History is a burden. Stories can make us fly."
—Robin Hood

quotes.name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
quotes.flavor: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

quotes.name: Sunmane Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

quotes.name: Dust Bowl
quotes.flavor: Dust Has No Time to Settle as New Dust Arrives

quotes.name: Qasali Pridemage
quotes.flavor: An elder in one pride, of the Sigiled caste in another.

quotes.name: Infernal Grasp
quotes.flavor: Ancient evils dwell within the burning chasm called the Ashmouth, ever ready to devour those foolish enough to travel alone.

quotes.name: Pious Warrior
quotes.flavor: The Cho-Arrim make no distinction between healers and soldiers.

quotes.name: Uncomfortable Chill
quotes.flavor:
"Tormented screams are like snowflakes: no two are quite the same."
—Pedor, ice witch

quotes.name: Discord, Lord of Disharmony
quotes.flavor: "Oh, what fun is there in making sense?"

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

quotes.name: Scour the Desert
quotes.flavor: Even in the most barren wastelands, every death feeds more life.

quotes.name: Cloak of Mists
quotes.flavor: Mystery lies beneath the haunting mists. Never stay where obscurity deepens.

quotes.name: Farhaven Elf
quotes.flavor:
"The leaves were long, the grass was green,
The hemlock-umbels tall and fair,
And in the glade a light was seen
Of stars in shadow shimmering."
—*Tale of Tinúviel*

quotes.name: Aven Windreader
quotes.flavor: "The tiniest ripple tells a story ten fathoms deep."

quotes.name: Temporal Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Of course she's at the head of her class. All of her classmates have disappeared."
—Tolarian renegade

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: As patient and generous as life, as harsh and merciless as nature.

quotes.name: Order of Leitbur
quotes.flavor:
"The powers of the corrupt will fade before the fury of the pure."
—Bethan Leitbur, "The Way"

quotes.name: End-Raze Forerunners
quotes.flavor:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Karn's Bastion
quotes.flavor: Wakanda's towering ingenuity is manifest across Birnin Zana's skyline.

quotes.name: Hall of Echoes
quotes.flavor: The tunnels below Hexhaven murmur with ripples of first breaths.

quotes.name: Ruric Thar, Magecrusher
quotes.flavor: "Can't cast spells with a broken mouth!"

quotes.name: Festercreep
quotes.flavor: A single festercreep isn't alone. It's already an infestation.

quotes.name: Living Hive
quotes.flavor: In its center is a single red ant, a queen that regulates the hive's movements.

quotes.name: Goblin Oriflamme
quotes.flavor:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Ashiok's Adept
quotes.flavor:
"Every nightmare is a caged bird that yearns to be set free."
—Ashiok, Nightmare Weaver

quotes.name: Fall of the Hammer
quotes.flavor: It is unwise to insult the god of the forge. It is also unwise to stand near anyone else who has insulted him.

quotes.name: Open the Vaults
quotes.flavor:
"It may be time to leave, but I'll never forget the day you all entered Vault 76."
—Overseer

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor:
"Good neighbors make good walls."
—Jakkarak the Maimer

quotes.name: Faithful Watchdog
quotes.flavor: Though its official designation was Third Battalion Patrol Hound 7, the soldiers dubbed their new companion Lord Fancy-Paws.

quotes.name: Torment of Venom
quotes.flavor: The Scorpion God's sting sends venom strong enough to poison blood, bone, and spirit.

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor: The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

quotes.name: Bloom Tender
quotes.flavor: Heart calmed by the beauty of the blossom, the dawnhand wondered who was actually protecting whom.

quotes.name: Virus Beetle
quotes.flavor:
"They'll be debugging their code for days before they figure out what happened!"
—Eita, Futurist agent

quotes.name: Inspiring Roar
quotes.flavor:
"This is about more than aether or inventions. Tezzeret's schemes must be stopped!"
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Mounted Dreadknight
quotes.flavor: Markov vampires cultivate an image of such decadent elegance that it can be easy to forget they can field a deadly fighting force.

quotes.name: Fleeting Image
quotes.flavor:
"Beware lest you lose the substance by grasping at the shadow."
—Aesop, *Fables*, trans. Jacobs

quotes.name: Crookshank Kobolds
quotes.flavor: The Crookshank military boasts a standing army of nearly twenty-four million, give or take twenty-two million.

quotes.name: Thought Reflection
quotes.flavor: Only when two oracles speak in unison is an omen accepted as truth.

quotes.name: Viridian Shaman
quotes.flavor: Because the elves are so in touch with Mirrodin's nature, they understand best how to dismantle it.

quotes.name: Jade Mage
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor:
"We are one with the wild things. Life blooms from our fingertips and nature responds to our summons."
—Jade creed

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Living Wall
quotes.flavor: Some fiendish mage had created a horrifying wall of living flesh, patched together from a jumble of still-recognizable body parts. As we sought to hew our way through it, some unknown power healed the gaping wounds we cut, denying us passage.

quotes.name: Supply-Line Cranes
quotes.flavor: They are trained from hatching to deliver aid where it is needed most.

quotes.name: Mind Slash
quotes.flavor: "I can't think with all that screaming."

quotes.name: Path of Ancestry
quotes.flavor: Merry gazed at the Púkel-men with wonder and pity, as they loomed up mournfully in the dusk.

quotes.name: Bloodbond Vampire
quotes.flavor:
"Let the vampires join us. In this war, we no longer have the luxury of choosing our comrades."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Hour of Promise
quotes.flavor: With the Hekma breached and its protection removed, the deserts swept in.

quotes.name: Serra Disciple
quotes.flavor: Theologians now believe the Ancestor was another divine form of Serra.

quotes.name: Moorish Cavalry
quotes.flavor: Members of the elite Moorish Cavalry are very particular about their mounts, choosing only those whose bloodlines have been pure for generations.

quotes.name: The Tarrasque
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: When it rises, nations fall.

quotes.name: Negate
quotes.flavor: "The ancient kor were a clever bunch with a taste for nasty traps. Spikes, poison, fire pouring forth with no warning . . . I've seen and disabled them all. If you intend to raid a Skyclave, you'd be wise to hire me on."

quotes.name: Atinlay Igpay
quotes.flavor: Isthay iecepay ofay avorflay exttay oesn'tday eallyray aysay anythingay.

quotes.name: Graf Mole
quotes.flavor:
"Their keen sense of smell draws them to the unnatural. To find one is a boon."
—Veka, hinterland inspector

quotes.name: Deadly Recluse
quotes.flavor: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

quotes.name: Infernius Spawnington III, Esq.
quotes.flavor: See evil, hear evil, speak evil.

quotes.name: Healer's Flock
quotes.flavor: The sight of a flock overhead is bittersweet. It means many are wounded, but it also means help is on the way.

quotes.name: Grand Melee
quotes.flavor: Hot blood washes away cold reason.

quotes.name: Aladdin's Ring
quotes.flavor:
"A good lamp will light your way. A good ring will clear it."
—Nervan, royal jeweler

quotes.name: Savor the Moment
quotes.flavor: "I do."

quotes.name: Goblin Firebomb
quotes.flavor:
"And if this works, Tawnos is gonna let us build the full-sized version!"
—Tergel, goblin explosioneer

quotes.name: Dimir Locket
quotes.flavor:
"Wear this, and take your place among the shadows—wise, lethal, and unseen."
—Ivrelya, Dimir spymaster

quotes.name: Empress Galina
quotes.flavor: "Above the waves you may be mighty indeed, but down here you belong to me."

quotes.name: Rograkh, Son of Rohgahh
quotes.flavor: Rograkh couldn't bear to watch his father pillage his own people. Not when there were so many other people they could pillage instead.

quotes.name: Wall of Granite
quotes.flavor: The wisest man builds his house *behind* the rock.

quotes.name: Andoria
quotes.flavor: "Imperial commander's log: It's refreshing to see the icy drifts of Andoria again. The warmth of Federation vessels has made me soft, and I prefer strength."

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Imperious Oligarch
quotes.flavor: The rights of ghosts are strictly protected under Orzhov bylaws, and those who enforce them can count on the ghosts' assistance.

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

quotes.name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
quotes.flavor: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.

quotes.name: Fallaji Excavation
quotes.flavor: Few relics excited Fallaji archaeologists more than Thran powerstones, which they called "eyes of the Old Ones."

quotes.name: Wild Growth
quotes.flavor: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Stonebinder's Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"Hey, my great-great-grandfather had a dog just like that!"
—Dradiel, Lorehold mage-student

quotes.name: Ripscale Predator
quotes.flavor: As Ravnica's wilds expanded, even advocates for nature had to confront fiercer natural threats.

quotes.name: Devastation
quotes.flavor: There is much talk about the art of creation. What about the art of destruction?

quotes.name: Archivist of Gondor
quotes.flavor: "If indeed you look only, as you say, for records of ancient days and the beginnings of the City, read on!"

quotes.name: Steelfin Whale
quotes.flavor: It feeds on metal filings suspended in the water, sieving flecks of precious ore through magnetic baleen.

quotes.name: Pithing Needle
quotes.flavor: Phyrexians spent countless hours unsuccessfully trying to harvest and recreate blinkmoth serum.

quotes.name: Skaab Wrangler
quotes.flavor: After Uda's hat boutique in Selhoff was destroyed by werewolves, she relocated outside of town and took up a new type of sewing.

quotes.name: Eliminate the Competition
quotes.flavor: Open hostilities are strictly forbidden at the Inventors' Fair, but "accidents" still happen.

quotes.name: Profane Transfusion
quotes.flavor:
"Those that fall short of perfection can still contribute to the Great Work."
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor

quotes.name: Haze of Pollen
quotes.flavor: Few can overcome an assault of such aggressive serenity.

quotes.name: Toxic Deluge
quotes.flavor:
"You must decide what you're willing to give to your spell craft: mana, pest essence, even your own life force. Everything is fair game for a resourceful mage."
—Willowdusk

quotes.name: Clone Legion
quotes.flavor: Their lust for battle was so great that they didn't care their enemies wore their own faces.

quotes.name: Cartouche of Knowledge
quotes.flavor: Cartouches chronicle the initiates' achievements in the trials.

quotes.name: Stirring Hopesinger
quotes.flavor: Though not all her students have wings, she's determined to help them reach new heights.

quotes.name: Raging Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The only thing worse than a minotaur with an axe is an angry minotaur with an axe.

quotes.name: Inspiring Call
quotes.flavor: "Sozin's comet is arriving and our destinies are upon us!"

quotes.name: Maggot Carrier
quotes.flavor:
"We do not suddenly fall on death, but advance towards it by slight degrees; we die every day."
—Seneca, *Epistles*, trans. Gummere

quotes.name: Fabrication Module
quotes.flavor: Inspiration leads to design.

quotes.name: Repurposing Bay
quotes.flavor: By the end of the race, few of the Aether Rangers' vehicles resembled what they started as.

quotes.name: Giant Cockroach
quotes.flavor: Toren had stepped on a lot of bugs during his life, so he couldn't help feeling embarrassed when a bug stepped on him.

quotes.name: Falkenrath Reaver
quotes.flavor:
"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia

quotes.name: Ignoble Hierarch
quotes.flavor: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.

quotes.name: Faerie Noble
quotes.flavor:
"Faeries talk all in riddles and tricky bits, 'cept the Nobles. Now, there's some straight talkers."
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

quotes.name: Springjaw Trap
quotes.flavor:
"Stop trying to pierce the hide. Hit where it's softest: ankle, sole, hamstring."
—Master Hunter Chevill

quotes.name: Abaddon the Despoiler
quotes.flavor: Under his rule, there is but one creed: Chaos shall reign.

quotes.name: Ancient Grudge
quotes.flavor: The time rifts remind Yavimaya of the enemies of its past and provide fresh fuel for its fires.

quotes.name: Bellowing Elk
quotes.flavor:
"Their two-tone vocalization contains a whistle and a roar. Both mean get away."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Scab-Clan Giant
quotes.flavor: For the Gruul, bone-crushing rage is the first priority. Accuracy comes in a distant ninetieth.

quotes.name: Needletooth Raptor
quotes.flavor: It hatches with its ferocity fully grown.

quotes.name: Ravaging Horde
quotes.flavor: Upon his return to the capitol after taking soldiers to loot a nearby peaceful town, the prime minister, Dong Zhou, boasted of it as a victory over bandits.

quotes.name: Territorial Scythecat
quotes.flavor: Standing between a scythecat and its prey makes you the appetizer.

quotes.name: Valakut Predator
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever volcanoes dream of, it seems like they always wake up grumpy."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Lord of Extinction
quotes.flavor: The forlorn cries of the dead combine to make its laugh.

quotes.name: Wandering Wolf
quotes.flavor: Humans still feared wolves, though no connection between them and the curse of lycanthropy had ever been proved.

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

quotes.name: Curious Colossus
quotes.flavor: Kithkin respect giants, but not usually from such close range.

quotes.name: Loyal Apprentice
quotes.flavor: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

quotes.name: Devil's Play
quotes.flavor: A devil's hands are never idle.

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: "Catch!"

quotes.name: Lava Serpent
quotes.flavor: Lavabrink's boiling moat is a deterrent for most, and a relaxing bath for one.

quotes.name: Skymarcher Aspirant
quotes.flavor: "I was born to glory."

quotes.name: Clowning Around
quotes.flavor: The Astrotorium's Clown-Bots are programmed to delight attendees by any means necessary.

quotes.name: Killer Bees
quotes.flavor: The communal mind produces a savage strategy, yet no one could predict that this vicious crossbreed would unravel the secret of steel.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

quotes.name: Encrust
quotes.flavor:
"The sea blesses the tiny with the power to fell the mighty."
—Talrand, sky summoner

quotes.name: Absorb
quotes.flavor: "Your presumption is your downfall."

quotes.name: Janice Rand, Essential Aide
quotes.flavor: The ever-resourceful Yeoman Rand approached scheduling conflicts and firefights with equal poise.

quotes.name: Grindclock
quotes.flavor: Pray you never hear it chime.

quotes.name: Arashin Sovereign
quotes.flavor: Dromoka dragons foster trust among their subjects, while the other clans must spend their time quelling rebellion.

quotes.name: Plaguecrafter
quotes.flavor: "Looks like I need a new test subject. Any volunteers?"

quotes.name: Elbrus, the Binding Blade // Withengar Unbound
quotes.flavor: Those who grasp its hilt soon hear the demon's call.

quotes.name: Overcome
quotes.flavor:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

quotes.name: Tomik, Distinguished Advokist
quotes.flavor: "Some bend the law. I tie it into knots."

quotes.name: Frodo, Determined Hero
quotes.set_name: Tales of Middle-earth Deluxe Commander Kit
quotes.flavor: Frodo's heart flamed within him. He drew his sword and advanced.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Loxodon Anchorite
quotes.flavor: The loxodon ascribe religious superiority to those born albino, believing them to be spiritually pure.

quotes.name: Armillary Sphere
quotes.flavor: The mysterious purpose of two of the rings had eluded Esper mages—until now.

quotes.name: Highborn Vampire
quotes.flavor: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

quotes.name: Sigiled Skink
quotes.flavor: The runes seem to come alive as it moves, rippling like slow flames across its scales.

quotes.name: Armus, Skin of Evil
quotes.flavor: The Vagrans cast off their evil, and it coalesced into a singular will.

quotes.name: Voracious Tome-Skimmer
quotes.flavor: She spoils the book before you read it.

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: Slain orochi warriors were buried with a tree sapling so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Azure Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We draw our power from the infinite ocean of the mind, where all manner of things can be conceived."
—Azure creed

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Towering-Wave Mystic
quotes.flavor: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

quotes.name: Happy Hogan, Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: "Move along folks. Move along."

quotes.name: Primal Huntbeast
quotes.flavor:
"To the unskilled, it appears as blurred patches of distorted light. Few have seen its true form."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Aven Squire
quotes.flavor: When the meek charge into battle, courage becomes infectious.

quotes.name: Benevolent Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: "My destiny is to save others so their destinies may be achieved."

quotes.name: Access Tunnel
quotes.flavor: Oriq agents stick to the dark corners of Arcavios, unseen yet ever-present.

quotes.name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
quotes.flavor: "I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."

quotes.name: Mawcor
quotes.flavor: From its maw comes neither word nor whisper—only wind.

quotes.name: Neurok Replica
quotes.flavor: All the curiosity of the Neurok with only a trace of their duplicity.

quotes.name: Peel from Reality
quotes.flavor: "Soulless demon, you are bound to me. Now we will both dwell in oblivion."

quotes.name: Azusa, Lost but Seeking
quotes.flavor: "With every step, I discover a new stage. With every breath, a new song."

quotes.name: Drownyard Temple
quotes.flavor:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Broken Wings
quotes.flavor:
"Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely. When the great eagle flew past, the hunter's aim was true."
—*Saga of the Wisdom Seeker*

quotes.name: Cry of the Carnarium
quotes.flavor: If your ears bleed, it's a party. If your eyes bleed, it's a Rakdos party.

quotes.name: Seasoned Marshal
quotes.flavor:
"We are not interested in the possibilities of defeat."
—Queen Victoria

quotes.name: Tectonic Break
quotes.flavor: Only the foolish and the rich build their houses where the land is thin and the ocean is near.

quotes.name: Zealous Persecution
quotes.flavor:
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder."
—Knight-Captain Wyhorn

quotes.name: Skullclamp
quotes.flavor:
"The flesh is weak! But steel! Steel is strong!"
—The Mechanist

quotes.name: Curse of Wizardry
quotes.flavor:
"We must all push through the pain to heal our world."
—Ayli, Kamsa cleric

quotes.name: Pierce Strider
quotes.flavor:
"Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Arcane Amphisbaena
quotes.flavor: Its tongues can taste loyalty—or deceit.

quotes.name: Path to Exile
quotes.flavor: For the crime of trying to save her brother, Kassandra was thrown from Mount Taygetos—forced into exile with nothing but a broken spear and the will to survive.

quotes.name: Vex
quotes.flavor:
"The druids would be better off if they spent more time in the lab and less time watching trees grow."
—Pontifex, elder researcher

quotes.name: Angelic Accord
quotes.flavor: As demons are drawn to suffering, angels are drawn to acts of benevolence.

quotes.name: Lure
quotes.flavor: It makes the insignificant conspicuous, the repulsive alluring, and the deadly irresistible.

quotes.name: Temporal Trespass
quotes.flavor: Few truly live in the moment.

quotes.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
quotes.flavor: Her centuries-long search is ended.

quotes.name: Brawn
quotes.flavor:
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered."
—*Scroll of Beginnings*

quotes.name: Copy Enchantment
quotes.flavor: Simic mages create redundant backups of their experiments to reduce the consequences of catastrophe.

quotes.name: Skullslither Worm
quotes.flavor: As larvae, they burrow into a host's brain to feed upon it, growing until they're large enough to burst free and seek out larger prey.

quotes.name: Ancient Cellarspawn
quotes.flavor: Where it treads, plants wither. Where it breathes, poison spreads.

quotes.name: Wyluli Wolf
quotes.flavor:
"When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?"
—Maimun al-Wyluli, diary

quotes.name: Segmented Wurm
quotes.flavor:
"If only we could so easily leave behind those parts of ourselves that pain us."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Anti-Venom, Horrifying Healer
quotes.flavor: "You are a sickness on this city. I am the cure!"

quotes.name: Pestered Wellguard
quotes.flavor: In silence, she cursed a thousand times the fact she'd been stationed near fae lands.

quotes.name: Hero's Blade
quotes.flavor: The best swords are forged with dragonfire.

quotes.name: Goblin Assault
quotes.flavor: A goblin raid is a delicate gambit—a blend of stealth, precision, and screaming death.

quotes.name: Chaos Maw
quotes.flavor: The food chain doesn't end at sandwurms.

quotes.name: Gixian Puppeteer
quotes.flavor: To some, desecration. To Gix, decoration.

quotes.name: Erratic Apparition
quotes.flavor:
"What's got you all bent out of shape?"
—Joseph, comedian, last words

quotes.name: Bristling Boar
quotes.flavor:
"Nicol Bolas destroyed my world. I owe it to Skalla to celebrate all life, no matter how dangerous."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Griffin Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Once a griffin sentinel adopts a territory as its own, only death can force it to betray its post.

quotes.name: Azorius Signet
quotes.flavor: The maze-like design embodies the core of Azorius law—strict structure designed to test wills and stall change.

quotes.name: Mist-Cloaked Herald
quotes.flavor: With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against enemy forces.

quotes.name: Bugenhagen, Wise Elder
quotes.flavor: "I've been thinking if there was anything we could do to help a planet already in misery..."

quotes.name: Silhana Ledgewalker
quotes.flavor: Street folk call them "spire mice," but behind the mockery is an unspoken envy of the ledgewalkers' skill at avoiding harm.

quotes.name: Bloodsworn Steward
quotes.flavor: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

quotes.name: Devil K. Nevil
quotes.flavor: "Danger is my middle name. Also, I don't know how to spell."

quotes.name: Mammoth Spider
quotes.flavor: Most spiders of Llanowar disdain elvish alliances. No elf has as many beautiful eyes or as many strong arms.

quotes.name: Dearly Departed
quotes.flavor:
"Never forget our ancestors. They have not forgotten us."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

quotes.name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
quotes.flavor: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

quotes.name: Erkenbrand, Lord of Westfold
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Down from the hills leaped Erkenbrand, lord of Westfold, and the hosts of Isengard roared in fear.

quotes.name: Tackle Artist
quotes.flavor: "Let's paint the field red!"

quotes.name: Ogre Slumlord
quotes.flavor:
"His tenement is filled with the most vile, disgusting vermin. It's infested with rats, too."
—Branko One-Ear

quotes.name: Accursed Marauder
quotes.flavor: The Accursed are ever drawn to the Hekma, as though its presence provides a brief respite in their lives of eternal torment.

quotes.name: Tenured Tethermage
quotes.flavor: "Today, you will be learning material repurposing and adaptation. This will be on the test."

quotes.name: Confront the Past
quotes.flavor: "Why, Gideon? Of all people, why save me?"

quotes.name: Prophetic Ravings
quotes.flavor: "Keep your herons and shrews! You will find nothing in the moon, for the moon is a lie! It has told me so!"

quotes.name: Ethereal Armor
quotes.flavor: Metal is scarce, smiths are pricey, and plate mail is heavy.

quotes.name: Sage's Row Denizen
quotes.flavor: "Forget what you have learned from other teachers. I bring you the truth."

quotes.name: Shattered Perception
quotes.flavor:
"You must shatter the fetters of the past. Only then can you truly act."
—Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"Never forget who you are and where you came from."
—Captain Marvel, Carol Danvers

quotes.name: Diregraf Captain
quotes.flavor: Though its mind has long since rotted away, it wields a sword with deadly skill.

quotes.name: Krosan Colossus
quotes.flavor: When it walked, it altered geography. When it bellowed, it changed the weather.

quotes.name: Travel Preparations
quotes.flavor: Visiting a shrine at the start of a journey makes the traveler more likely to finish it.

quotes.name: Open the Gates
quotes.flavor:
"If you don't have a destination in mind, the route is all that matters."
—Tamina, district guide

quotes.name: Vampire Nighthawk
quotes.flavor: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans. Others were unable to make the adjustment.

quotes.name: Exchange of Words
quotes.flavor: Before criticizing, walk a mile *(about 1.6 kilometers)* in their head. That way, when you do, you're a mile away and you have their head.

quotes.name: Generous Gift
quotes.flavor:
"Do I need a reason to want to help out a friend?"
—Sonic the Hedgehog

quotes.name: Yuan-Ti Malison
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Silent. Slithering. Sinister.

quotes.name: Turn the Tide
quotes.flavor:
"Let their mindless armies come and face the might of genius."
—Varil, Neurok partisan

quotes.name: Chronicler of Heroes
quotes.flavor: She paints pictures with words, though not all pictures show the truth.

quotes.name: Fickle Efreet
quotes.flavor: Flame chooses its own course.

quotes.name: Candlegrove Witch
quotes.flavor: "Like a thousand candles fighting back the darkness, we are strongest when we stand together."

quotes.name: Rot-Tide Gargantua
quotes.flavor: Now that it doesn't need to breathe, its hunting ground extends well beyond the sea.

quotes.name: Rapid Rescue
quotes.flavor: Another day, another disaster.

quotes.name: Mortician Beetle
quotes.flavor: To the soldier, war is famine; to the scavenger, a feast.

quotes.name: Highway Robber
quotes.flavor: "Tonight, madam, it's your money *and* your life."

quotes.name: Stillness in Motion
quotes.flavor: "The Meditation Realm is a willful puzzle. Seek, and it will impede. Wait, and it will permit passage."

quotes.name: Fangblade Brigand // Fangblade Eviscerator
quotes.flavor: As long as the sun is up, you'll only lose your purse.

quotes.name: Spikeshot Goblin
quotes.flavor:
"Proximity discouraged. Do not approach."
—Vulshok field guide

quotes.name: Ethersworn Canonist
quotes.flavor: "The noble work of our order is to infuse all life on Esper with etherium. Our goal will be reached more rapidly if new life is . . . suppressed."

quotes.name: Order of the Sacred Bell
quotes.flavor: "My brother, it may now be time to ring the bell and put out the call for aid."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Monitor
quotes.flavor: Being one would be an honor, if the word "honor" had any meaning in Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Jinxed Idol
quotes.flavor: "Here."

quotes.name: Sightless Ghoul
quotes.flavor: It blindly marches on Thraben's gates, guided by its master's direful will.

quotes.name: Culling Dais
quotes.flavor:
"Forswear the flesh and you will truly see."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

quotes.name: Morale
quotes.flavor: "After Lacjsi's speech, the Knights grew determined to crush their ancient enemies clan by clan." —Tivadar of Thorn, *History of the Goblin Wars*

quotes.name: Powerstone Shard
quotes.flavor:
"Light passing through a powerstone is refracted by eternity and colored by planar energy. I wonder how the world appeared through Urza's eyes?"
—Teferi

quotes.name: Golden-Tail Disciple
quotes.flavor: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.

quotes.name: Ironshell Beetle
quotes.flavor:
"Why waste time creating weapons? Nature provides us with all we need."
—Centaur warrior

quotes.name: Stargaze
quotes.flavor:
"I stay away from poems about the night. It's beautiful, yes, but somehow it always feels just a little bit hungry."
—Abigale

quotes.name: Lash of Thorns
quotes.flavor:
"Another angry mob? When will they learn to leave me be?"
—Terryn, Edgewall outcast

quotes.name: Mogg Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "I got it! I got it! I—"

quotes.name: Centrifuge
quotes.flavor: The back of each ticket features a map to the lost and found.

quotes.name: Akroan Mastiff
quotes.flavor: Even when many of the soldiers who guarded Akros were called away, its safety was never in doubt.

quotes.name: Goblin Chieftain
quotes.flavor:
*Goblin_Welder:* #blessed
*Thrun_TheLastTroll:* #gross

quotes.name: Heroic Intervention
quotes.flavor: "I just want to do everything in my power to help. All of you... and the planet."

quotes.name: Great Oak Guardian
quotes.flavor: Ent the earthborn, old as mountains.

quotes.name: Teferi's Veil
quotes.flavor:
"I don't like to speak ill of 'walkers . . . but just what did Teferi think he was doing?"
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Mesa Lynx
quotes.flavor: Its ferocity is tempered by patience, knowing it must wait for just the right moment to strike a killing blow.

quotes.name: Tidy Conclusion
quotes.flavor: Aetherborn patrons use any means necessary to secure victory for their protégés.

quotes.name: Aven Reedstalker
quotes.flavor: "Our best chance against the Eternals will be tactics they've never seen and styles they've never trained in."

quotes.name: Legion's Landing // Adanto, the First Fort
quotes.flavor:
"I claim this land in the name of the queen."
—Adrian Adanto of Lujio

quotes.name: Woodland Stream
quotes.flavor: Waterways carve their routes through the land to reflect the paths the aether streams cut through the clouds.

quotes.name: Wicked Guardian
quotes.flavor: "Some are born to greatness. You were born to scrub greatness's floors."

quotes.name: Sanitarium Skeleton
quotes.flavor: His mind was lost long before his flesh.

quotes.name: Skull of Orm
quotes.flavor: Though lifeless, the Skull still possessed a strange power over the flow of magic.

quotes.name: Grand Abolisher
quotes.flavor: "Dual Blades? Check. Tigrex armor? Check. Monster? Let's hunt."

quotes.name: Thriving Grove
quotes.flavor: Far from human eyes, birds flit between vivid blossoms in a hidden paradise.

quotes.name: Propaganda
quotes.flavor:
"It's subtler than that. Any stronger and people would question it. But contained in that rhythm, in layers of code, Vote Saxon. Believe in me. Whispering to the world."
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Mishra's Bauble
quotes.flavor:
"Arcum is a babbling fool! Phyrexian technology is our greatest blessing. Take this delightful trinket for instance . . ."
—Heidar, Rimewind master

quotes.name: Wretched Throng
quotes.flavor:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words

quotes.name: Geist of Saint Thalia
quotes.flavor: "Be at peace, child. The horrors will not claim you this night."

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind
quotes.flavor: Niv-Mizzet's genius and vanity reverberate throughout the mirrored halls of Nivix.

quotes.name: Flaxen Intruder // Welcome Home
quotes.flavor: The middle blade was just right.

quotes.name: Urza's Mine
quotes.flavor: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

quotes.name: Kitesail Corsair
quotes.flavor: "Why perch in the crow's nest when I can fly like the crows?"

quotes.name: Sylvan Basilisk
quotes.flavor:
"We're not sure what one looks like, so to be safe, nobody look at anything until we're out of here."
—Parbold Drix, veteran explorer

quotes.name: Dismiss
quotes.flavor:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Sorin's Thirst
quotes.flavor: "All your steel won't protect you if your will is weak."

quotes.name: Tarmogoyf
quotes.flavor: What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the tarmogoyf.

quotes.name: Storied Veteran
quotes.flavor: "There we were at the K-7 cantina. Kirk's savage crew breathing down our necks. Their tribbles with fangs as sharp as a *mek'leth*."

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: Knowing Takenuma Swamp to be dangerous, Hisata set wards to warn him of predators. He never imagined that his murderer would pass through them unhindered.

quotes.name: Boldwyr Intimidator
quotes.flavor: "Now everyone knows what you are."

quotes.name: Tavern Scoundrel
quotes.flavor: "No refunds. I cheated you fair and square."

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: The people of the Sun Empire worship the sun in three aspects: the creative sun, the sustaining sun, and the destructive sun.

quotes.name: Cruel Grimnarch
quotes.flavor: The gospel of lies sounds sweetest when whispered by many mouths.

quotes.name: Herbology Instructor // Malady Invoker
quotes.flavor: "As you see, these flowers . . . can have either restorative or poisonous . . . what is that?"

quotes.name: Lullmage Mentor
quotes.flavor: "Many voices are needed to quiet this land."

quotes.name: Gimli, Counter of Kills
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Twenty-one!" cried Gimli. He hewed a two- handed stroke and laid the last Orc before his feet. "Now my count passes Master Legolas."

quotes.name: Killmonger, Ruthless Usurper
quotes.flavor: "Join me, run, or die. The choice is yours."

quotes.name: Wake the Past
quotes.flavor: Everyone thought RobCo's Assaultron reserves were decimated in the Great War. In reality, they were merely dormant.

quotes.name: Mythos of Nethroi
quotes.flavor:
"And then the shadow took living form, and the shadow devoured the man whole—body, mind, and soul."
—*Tales of the Ozolith*

quotes.name: Warped Landscape
quotes.flavor: Each cryptolith twists the plane's mana, bending its flow to a singular purpose.

quotes.name: Malfunctioning Holodeck
quotes.flavor:
"The holodeck safeties are still engaged, right?"
—Ensign Kei

quotes.name: Lumbering Worldwagon
quotes.flavor: Go everywhere. See everything.

quotes.name: Bontu's Last Reckoning
quotes.flavor: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

quotes.name: Heat Ray
quotes.flavor:
"There was clearly a scream. I'm not sure if there was a mouth."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Think Twice
quotes.flavor: "Either I know just the spell I need, or I'm about to."

quotes.name: Rigging Runner
quotes.flavor: "Prepare to be boarded! Or don't. I'm coming over either way."

quotes.name: Moxite Refinery
quotes.flavor: Within moxite lies the ability for a ship's drive to pierce the Chaos Wall. Without it, the Edge becomes much smaller.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor:
"The Phyrexian's monuments of today will be nothing but dust tomorrow. With enough tomorrows, so will their rule."
—Koth

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Aerialist
quotes.flavor: A circus acrobat in life, she kills with such fluid grace that even her victims are awed by her performance.

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: The Changer of Ways often sends glimpses of possible futures to his most loyal acolytes, visions that would destroy lesser minds.

quotes.name: Wind Dancer
quotes.flavor: The sky is her stage.

quotes.name: Loot, the Anomaly
quotes.flavor: Loot's value is absolute in any Multiverse, so Jace kept him locked away and hidden.

quotes.name: Footbottom Feast
quotes.flavor: The scent of rot and vinegar fills the marsh, inviting boggarts from every warren to reunite and feast.

quotes.name: Hellkite Hatchling
quotes.flavor: A killing machine from birth.

quotes.name: Unstable Obelisk
quotes.flavor: Its collapse is like the lashing out of a long-dead civilization that resents being forgotten.

quotes.name: Exdeath, Void Warlock // Neo Exdeath, Dimension's End
quotes.flavor: "Mwa-hahahaha! Witness what befalls those who stand against me!"

quotes.name: Estrid's Invocation // Estrid's Invocation
quotes.flavor:
"Purely enchanting. The magic will linger long after you've reached the end."
—Talion, the Kindly Lord

quotes.name: Diabolic Edict
quotes.flavor: Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?"
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Destroy Evil
quotes.flavor: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

quotes.name: Thunder Dragon
quotes.flavor: Sometimes primitive cultures attributed natural phenomena to monsters. Sometimes they were right.

quotes.name: Golgari Charm
quotes.flavor:
"Let the rest of Ravnica sneer. One way or another, they all end up in the undercity."
—Jarad

quotes.name: Incremental Growth
quotes.flavor: The bonds of family cross the boundaries of race.

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor:
「彼女が操る獣たちは、死の静寂を予告するような轟音をあげた。」
――「多元宇宙の形而上史学」

quotes.name: Erode
quotes.flavor:
"Our lives are built upon our pasts. What happens, then, if we are cut off from them?"
—Augusta, dean of order

quotes.name: Long-Term Plans
quotes.flavor: "Wait, it'll come to me in a minute."

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor:
"It's me and Gribble's special fort. None of the bad things can get us in there."
—Toby

quotes.name: Thespian's Stage
quotes.flavor: "All the world's a stage," said the Doctor. "Hmm. I might use that." pondered Shakespeare.

quotes.name: Bronze Calendar
quotes.flavor: Every page holds a month, every date a numeral.

quotes.name: Tempest Djinn
quotes.flavor: "Oh, yes, many have come to take my power for their own. They will tell you all about their exploits when you meet them on the sea floor."

quotes.name: Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Promos
quotes.flavor: "Ah, my old friends. Have you decided at last to stop clinging to the past and join me in the grand pursuit of perfection?"

quotes.name: Dracogenesis
quotes.flavor: Ugin and the dragonstorms of Tarkir are intrinsically linked. With his death they weakened. With his life they raged. But even the Spirit Dragon does not hold them fully under his sway.

quotes.name: Well of Discovery
quotes.flavor:
When you have given everything, then you are capable of anything.
—Well inscription

quotes.name: Lesser Gargadon
quotes.flavor:
"In some cultures, elephants are ridden by those in power. I don't think a mere elephant would even be noticed in Keld."
—Onean sergeant

quotes.name: Doors of Durin
quotes.flavor: "Speak, friend, and enter."

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

quotes.name: Shrapnel Blast
quotes.flavor: To the Krark Clan, every artifact has a trigger and a barrel.

quotes.name: Redress Fate
quotes.flavor: "I can't go with you into the House, but I can give you one chance to reverse your doom. Make it count."

quotes.name: Cryptek
quotes.flavor: There are those who draw false comparisons between the tech-magi of the Adeptus Mechanicus and the xenotechnologists of the necron race. There can be no mercy for such heretics.

quotes.name: Universal Surveillance
quotes.flavor: Few outside the Saiba Futurists know the true extent of their data-extraction network.

quotes.name: Biomechan Engineer
quotes.flavor: "Life is a pattern, not a material."

quotes.name: Deflection
quotes.flavor:
"You've thrown your net at the wrong fish."
—The Lord of Atlantis

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.

quotes.name: Permission Denied
quotes.flavor: "Ah, ah, ah! You didn't say the magic word."

quotes.name: Ferrovore
quotes.flavor: The Vulshok use its digestion to break down the most obstinate artifacts, from darksteel myr to seastrider plates.

quotes.name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
quotes.flavor: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

quotes.name: Aquus Steed
quotes.flavor: In water, it's as graceful as a dolphin. On land, it darts and jerks so unpredictably that few can ride it for long.

quotes.name: Necrosavant
quotes.flavor:
"Ah, I remember my first death."
—Zarkuu, necrosavant

quotes.name: Royal Assassin
quotes.flavor: Trained in the arts of stealth, royal assassins choose their victims carefully, relying on timing and precision rather than brute force.

quotes.name: Farhaven Elf
quotes.flavor: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

quotes.name: Crystal Ball
quotes.flavor: It glints with arcane truths to those who know how to glimpse them.

quotes.name: Talisman of Dominance
quotes.flavor: Ultron created endless backups, each containing his accumulated data and his ruthless core directive to reign supreme.

quotes.name: Ministrant of Obligation
quotes.flavor: When the price of your sins comes due, the Church of Deals is there to collect.

quotes.name: Dragon Moose
quotes.flavor: Noble passengers require noble transportation.

quotes.name: Sisay's Ring
quotes.flavor: "I'm not one for pretty things," said Sisay. "Unless they're pretty useful as well."

quotes.name: Sickle Ripper
quotes.flavor: His sickle was forged in the heat of another cinder's funeral pyre.

quotes.name: Wall of Razors
quotes.flavor:
"In this blessed structure let the very walls baptize themselves in the blood of intruders."
—Stronghold architect, journal

quotes.name: Glimmering Angel
quotes.flavor:
"We turned to see where the blow came from and saw only a distant light."
—Capashen lord

quotes.name: Hero of Goma Fada
quotes.flavor: "They seek to break us. Let us show them our strength!"

quotes.name: Crowned Ceratok
quotes.flavor: The best way to calm a rampaging ceratok is to wait until it dies of natural causes.

quotes.name: Radiant Strike
quotes.flavor:
"The light does not ask permission to cut through the darkness."
—Mentor Ultimate, to Regent Maximum Taman IV

quotes.name: Staggering Insight
quotes.flavor:
"Only cowards flee from the truth."
—Perisophia the philosopher

quotes.name: Benalish Hero
quotes.flavor: Benalia has a complex caste system that changes with the lunar year. No matter what the season, the only caste that cannot be attained by either heredity or money is that of the Hero.

quotes.name: Component Collector
quotes.flavor: "Keep master busy with new bits or else maybe she wonders if I'm made of bits too."

quotes.name: Sunscorched Divide
quotes.flavor:
"You there! We're about to storm the castle. The two of you will join the assault squad. Get moving!"
-—Imperial soldier

quotes.name: Lightning Shrieker
quotes.flavor: Dragonslayers learned to keep silent about their deeds after seeing the terrible vengeance wrought by Kolaghan and her brood.

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor:
"Better to let the sword go than to lose the arm with it."
—Captain Lannery Storm

quotes.name: Rabid Bite
quotes.flavor:
"You should have seen the look on *both* their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

quotes.name: Skirsdag High Priest
quotes.flavor: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

quotes.name: Shatter
quotes.flavor: The ogre's mind snapped. The bow was next. The archer followed quickly after.

quotes.name: The Prismatic Piper
quotes.flavor: It is everything and nothing.

quotes.name: Scapeshift
quotes.flavor:
"These people come from their cities and think to tame the wilderness. They forget that here, the wilderness has a head start."
—Selvala

quotes.name: Puncture Blast
quotes.flavor: Gnarltrunk didn't remember having quite that many knotholes.

quotes.name: Doc Ock's Tentacles
quotes.flavor: Once powerful tools of science, Dr. Otto Octavius's mechanical arms became his most formidable weapons.

quotes.name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
quotes.flavor: A font of knowledge for those able to read more than a page of hexed words.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Prismatic Omen
quotes.flavor:
"There would be time later to mourn the lost, to weep for their fallen homes and lost treasures. But for now, they breathed in the untainted air and allowed themselves to hope again."
—*Last Stand of the Realm*

quotes.name: Dominating Vampire
quotes.flavor: "You can join me or feed me. Choose fast."

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor: In the cold corridors of the undercity, misinformation unfurls from Duskmantle like a spreading stain.

quotes.name: Signal Pest
quotes.flavor: It leaps from tree to tree, revealing the enemy's positions.

quotes.name: Ambush
quotes.flavor:
"Don't these goons have anything better to do?"
—Joskun, An-Havva Constable

quotes.name: Time Stretch
quotes.flavor:
"I swear, I just wanted a few extra hours to do my homework!"
—Petra, novice chronomancer

quotes.name: Seismic Spike
quotes.flavor: Natural disasters in Ravnica are largely nullified by the Izzet. Unnatural disasters, on the other hand, happen all the time.

quotes.name: Jennika's Technique
quotes.flavor: "Of course it's dangerous. That's the whole point of a weapon!"

quotes.name: Fallen Askari
quotes.flavor: In troubled times, there are few greater sorrows than a wayward savior.

quotes.name: Mark of Mutiny
quotes.flavor: The flame of anger is hard to douse once lit.

quotes.name: Sek'Kuar, Deathkeeper
quotes.flavor: Karplusan legend told of an orc so cruel that he burned his own followers in rage—yet so revered that they rose from their pyres to serve him.

quotes.name: Iron-Fist Pulverizer
quotes.flavor:
"The 3:10 to Omenport will be delayed."
—Prosperity Station announcement

quotes.name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
quotes.flavor: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

quotes.name: Wildwood Patrol
quotes.flavor: If you're lucky, the centaurs will give a single warning to leave their territory before driving a spear into you. If you're unlucky, the spear is the warning.

quotes.name: Llanowar Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Most people can't build decent weapons out of stone or steel. Trust the elves to do it with only mud and vines."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Drogskol Reaver
quotes.flavor: Wracked and warped with anguish, it obsessively seeks out other souls to hoard within its eternal prison.

quotes.name: Marauding Knight
quotes.flavor: "They ride our trails as if they were designed to," said the guard. "They were," replied Gerrard.
